statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Broad equity weakness, Brent above $109, near-5% Treasury yields and weak megacap breadth keep Stress extreme, while stronger semiconductor breadth and unavailable direct NQ retracement-quality evidence keep Tail below elevated.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the elevated threshold; a higher band would require verified persistent NQ extension, shallow pullbacks, failed retracements or session-extreme holding.
headline: Oil and rates keep Tail in WATCH; Stress is extreme while semiconductor breadth conflicts
body: AP reported the Nasdaq down 0.7% at 12:52 p.m. ET with the 10-year Treasury yield near 5%. Reuters later reported Brent at $109.20 and WTI at $106.46. Fresh supplementary breadth showed six of eight tracked megacaps lower but six of seven tracked semiconductors higher. Direct current NQ retracement and extension structure was not independently available.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail ranged from 18% to 22%. It was mostly low overnight, moved into WATCH through much of Tuesday morning, briefly eased around the U.S. open, and returned to WATCH as broad U.S. weakness and oil-rate pressure persisted.
outlookSummary: Current Tail remains in WATCH as broad equity weakness, high oil and near-5% Treasury yields sustain extreme Stress, but direct no-retracement NQ evidence remains unavailable and semiconductor breadth is firmer. Power hour is the nearest danger window; Wednesday's 12:30 UTC data, cash open and later FOMC sequence keep forward Stress high.

forecast.analysis: Nasdaq was down 0.7%, 10Y near 5%, and Brent later reached $109.20. Firmer semis conflict with weaker megacaps; direct current NQ retracement evidence is unavailable.
drivers: Oil and near-5% yields sustain pressure

forecast.analysis: Power hour is the nearest danger window. Tail reaches 24% only if session-extreme holding, failed rebounds or shallow pullbacks confirm persistent extension.
Post-close Tail falls to low if after-hours trade restores ordinary retracement; continued extension without meaningful pullbacks would invalidate that path.
Orderly two-sided after-hours trade keeps Tail low. A fresh shock matters for Tail only with sustained NQ follow-through.
Balanced evening price discovery keeps Tail low; repeated cross-asset extension with poor NQ retracement would be the escalation signal.
drivers: Poor NQ retracement with cross-asset extension

forecast.analysis: Late-evening Tail stays low if trade remains two-sided. A persistent break holding with shallow pullbacks would be the contrary structure.
At the Asia transition, two-sided trade keeps Tail low. A break that holds through the handoff with shallow pullbacks would raise path risk.
Orderly early Asia keeps Tail low. Cross-asset alignment becomes material to Tail only if NQ also shows persistent extension.
Quieter overnight trade keeps Tail low while retracements remain available. Repeated failed pullbacks would be the main invalidation.

At the Europe transition, Tail stays low if the handoff rotates. Rates and oil amplify Tail only with persistent NQ structure.

forecast.analysis: European trade keeps Tail low without a persistent NQ leg. Failed retracement followed by extension would be the contrary pattern.

drivers: Rates, oil and megacaps are conditional amplifiers

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the 12:30 UTC releases. Tail rises only if the post-release move persists with shallow pullbacks or failed retracements.
The 13:30 UTC cash open follows the data. Tail reaches 24% only if opening direction persists with shallow pullbacks or session-extreme holding.
The first full cash hour remains WATCH conditionally. Repeated extension after failed retracements sustains risk; rotation reduces it.
Post-open Tail stays at the WATCH floor if price discovery is unsettled. A two-sided range lowers risk; renewed extension sustains WATCH.
Meaningful afternoon retracement would lower Tail. The 18:00 UTC FOMC decision is a later Stress checkpoint, not an assumed reaction.
The final full pre-FOMC hour is WATCH. The 18:00 decision and 18:30 press conference are multi-stage checkpoints; elevated Tail still requires current path evidence.
